notes: The two assigned records have identical references, study identifiers, neutral descriptions, requested metrics, and page locators. No outcome or contrast distinguishes them. Original PDF p. 4 (journal p. 157) contains multiple Experiment 2 results (mental-rotation response time and accuracy, working-memory accuracy, main effects and interactions) and combined-experiment analyses. Replication PDF p. 7 contains Figure 2 for both experiments and Table 1 for Experiment 1; the Experiment 2 tests are in Tables 4–6 on PDF pp. 8–9. Thus neither a unique outcome nor a unique test can be assigned independently to either ID, and values are left null instead of assigning tests by input order. Both full texts were available and their titles matched the references. The reported-success field records the authors' explicit overall-paper verdict; it is not an effect-specific verdict for these unresolved targets.
